title: Modeled progress of a throttled backfill
method: Synthetic 1,000,000-row backfill uses 1,000-row batches taking 0.2 s plus 0.8 s pause, giving 1,000 rows/s. Progress at 250,500 and 1,000 s is 250,000,500,000 and 1,000,000. Excludes contention, retries and final reconciliation.
alt: Modeled progress of a throttled backfill. 250 seconds: 250000 rows completed; 500 seconds: 500000 rows completed; 1,000 seconds: 1e+06 rows completed. Illustrative values.
